teams.project_title: Autonomous Campus Renewable Microgrid Load Balancer
teams.hardware_components: Arduino Mega 2560, ACS712 Current Sensors, ZMPT101B Voltage Sensors, Solid State Relays (40A)
teams.problem_description: Campuses experience erratic power distribution and waste diesel generator fuel during peak hours.
teams.solution_description: An intelligent power controller utilizing deep Q-learning to dynamically shift heavy HVAC loads to solar battery banks.
teams.technologies_used: Next.js, PyTorch, Node-RED, Modbus TCP, TimescaleDB

teams.project_title: Dynamic Refreshable Braille Slate with Voice OCR
teams.expected_outcome: Affordable dynamic Braille reading device manufactured under INR 4,500.
teams.hardware_components: STM32 Nucleo Board, 192 Micro-solenoid Actuators, OV5640 Camera Module, Bone-conduction Audio Transducer
teams.problem_description: Commercial refreshable Braille displays cost upwards of $2,000, rendering them inaccessible to 95% of visually impaired students.
teams.solution_description: A low-cost 32-cell electromagnetic Braille display combined with an overhead camera that performs optical character recognition.
teams.technologies_used: Python OpenCV, Tesseract OCR, PyTorch, Node.js API

teams.hardware_components: ESP32 DevKit, Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensors, NPK Soil Sensor, 12V Solenoid Valves, LoRa Ra-02 Module
teams.project_title: Precision Soil Health & Automated Irrigation System
teams.technologies_used: Next.js, Python, Flask, TensorFlow Lite, MQTT, InfluxDB
teams.problem_description: Traditional farming leads to 40% water wastage and excessive chemical fertilizer usage due to lack of real-time soil nutrient and moisture data.
teams.solution_description: An edge-AI enabled smart telemetry system with multi-depth soil probes, automated solenoid irrigation valves, and a React Native dashboard.
teams.expected_outcome: 35% water savings and early detection of nutrient deficiencies.

teams.project_title: Non-Invasive Wearable Cardiac & Hypoxia Alert Band
teams.expected_outcome: Continuous 24-hr vitals monitoring with sub-3 second emergency trigger.
teams.solution_description: A wristband running lightweight tinyML for anomaly classification in PPG waveform with GSM-assisted SOS beaconing.
teams.problem_description: Rural patients experiencing arrhythmia and nocturnal hypoxia often face delayed emergency response due to absence of affordable continuous telemetry.
teams.hardware_components: Raspberry Pi Pico W, MAX30102 PPG Sensor, AD8232 ECG Sensor, SIM800L GSM Module, 0.96 OLED Display

teams.expected_outcome: Zero false negatives in safety hazard classification.
teams.technologies_used: C++, OpenCV, CUDA, TensorRT, Electron Dashboard
teams.hardware_components: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, Dual Global Shutter CSI Cameras, Optocoupler Relay Isolation Board
teams.solution_description: Stereo-vision edge module tracking operator hands, predicting trajectory, and triggering electronic emergency brakes in 40ms.
teams.problem_description: Accidents at mechanical presses occur when operators bypass safety light curtains during shifts.
